name: Apple Notes
_comment: No sign-in: Notes.app on this Mac already holds the account. Connect runs one read against Notes, which makes macOS ask once whether Fused may control it (Automation consent); the record stores the kind and the default account's name, never a credential. Off a Mac the card says so and offers nothing.
privacy: Fused talks to the Notes app on this Mac, the way Shortcuts does: no sign-in, no token, and Fused sends nothing anywhere. A note in a synced account (iCloud) syncs through Notes to your other devices as usual. macOS asks once whether to allow it (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation).
